reviews.body: Thanks for the fix! I checked the diff: the new `replay_text` policy is matched on `deepseek-v4`, `deepseek-flash` and `kimi-k2` before the informational fragments, so `deepseek-reasoner` and the other informational ids stay unchanged. `to_openai_dict` now keeps `reasoning_content` for that policy and still omits `signature`. The new tests cover policy resolution, serialisation without a signature, and a tool-call turn in request building. CI (3.11/3.12/3.13, frontend, smoke, docs) and CLA are all green. Merging.
